_meta.name: Frequent Mental Distress (BRFSS State Median)
_meta.unit: percent of adults, median across states and DC
_meta.source: CDC, BRFSS Prevalence and Trends Data
_meta.note: Mental health not good on 14 or more of the past 30 days. CDC's own published median across all states and DC (not a population-weighted national average; BRFSS does not publish one in this table). This resource starts in 2019, with six annual readings through 2024 in the verified edition, a named short-coverage exception. Pre-2019 coverage, including 2011–2018, needs annual XPT microdata and _LLCPWT weighting not currently read by this pipeline; those years are omitted, not interpolated.
_meta.method: Socrata Healthy Days / 14+ days when mental health not good; discover and validate median location, select Overall breakout, check distinct-year coverage
_meta.breaks: none known within 2019–2024 (the 2011 sampling redesign predates this series); CDC state median, not population-weighted
